title: Game speed
summary: Fast forward on the map and the battle speed limit.

sections.heading: On the Dashboard
steps: The Game speed card says if 2x speed and the battle speed limit are on.
Turn on 2x speed lets the host and players fast forward on the campaign map.
Turn on battle speed limit puts time back to normal speed while any player is in a battle.
Players change the speed with the map time buttons, or the keys 1, 2 and 3.

sections.heading: When it takes effect
steps: A running server keeps its old speed until it restarts. Click Restart server on the card.
sections.tip: The same choices are in the Game speed group at the top of the Settings page.
